key_findings: Microsoft completed its acquisition of Activision Blizzard on 2023-10-13, placing the Activision/Sierra corporate catalogue inside Microsoft ownership.
Corporate succession is strong evidence for a licensing route but is not equivalent to proof of every title-level or component-level right.
Many Sierra AGI/SCI adventures are supported by ScummVM, making this family an excellent second large engine-aware BYOG corpus after Lucasfilm.
ScummVM runtime licensing and Sierra game-data rights must remain separate.
Dynamix requires its own title/runtime grouping even though its later corporate history runs through Sierra.
RGME should model an IP steward/licensing route separately from corporate parent ownership.

architecture_finding.reason: The company controlling a corporate group is not necessarily the legal entity directly holding each historical copyright or trademark.
